title: Kamal Hinduja Geneva, Swiss : How do I create a custom character in RPG Maker ?

posts.author: kamalhinduja123
posts.body:
Hi All,
I'm Kamal Hinduja, a storyteller based in Geneva, Switzerland (Swiss) . Can anyone share tips on how to create a custom character in RPG Maker?
Thanks in advance!
Kamal Hinduja Geneva, Switzerland

posts.author: Robro33
posts.body:
If you already know how to create the art, you should aim to learn about the asset standards. With some exceptions, every image the engine needs has to be visually formatted in a certain way for it to use them properly. The help file within the main menu of the editor has the details
Itll save you from making something just for it the be unusable in the end and have to be remade
